clue.text: Smouldering leaves catching fire

indicators.note: catching means holding inside, so the run of letters across these two clue words is held within them

explanation.surface: Smouldering leaves in a garden heap start to catch fire.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a fire burning on a domestic hearth, an old Scots word kept alive in inglenook.

clue.text: Bitter gin and 'It' drunk around mid-morning

indicators.note: around means wrapping round, so the jumbled letters enclose the centre letter
drunk means intoxicated and so jumbled up, so these letters are rearranged
mid means the central letter of the word morning is taken

explanation.surface: Someone sour about a gin and It cocktail knocked back before noon.
explanation.walkthrough: Gin and It is gin with Italian vermouth. 'drunk' makes INDIGANT, and 'around' puts it round N, the middle of 'morning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Indignant means resentful at unfairness, a bitter feeling of grievance.

clue.text: One plays start of Metal Gear excitedly

indicators.note: excitedly suggests agitation, so these letters are stirred into a new order
start of means the first letter of the word metal is taken

explanation.surface: A player launching the game Metal Gear in a state of excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: Metal Gear is a video game series. 'excitedly' rearranges M and GEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamer is someone who plays games, especially video games.

clue.text: Sweetheart scoffed about chap getting discharge

parts.note: the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter
a chap is a man
to scoff is to eat greedily, so scoffed means ate

explanation.surface: A girlfriend ate around a man who was then sent off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweetheart' reads as a lover, but it is the heart of 'sweet'.
explanation.definitionFit: To emanate is to flow out or issue from a source, as to discharge does.

clue.text: Attire dishevelled by supporter upset referee

indicators.note: in this clue upset means knocked over, so the word for the supporter is read backwards

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

indicators.note: dishevelled means messed up and untidy, so the letters of attire are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's clothes are rumpled by an aggrieved fan who then rounds on the official.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supporter' looks like a sports fan but is the undergarment, turned by 'upset'; 'referee' is a verb here. 'dishevelled' gives ITRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To referee a dispute is to judge between the parties, which is what arbitrating means.

clue.text: Brilliant time embracing very ordinary bird

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so the first pieces wrap around the others

parts.note: ace is slang for brilliant
O is the abbreviation for ordinary, as in O level exams

explanation.surface: A wonderful moment spent with a very ordinary bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocet is a black-and-white wading bird with an upturned bill.

clue.text: Singer's block on single about sex

parts.note: a bar blocks a way, as in bar the door
it is slang for sex or sex appeal
one means single

explanation.surface: A vocalist's single, a record about sex, being blocked.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means placed above. 'About' is loose here: the single stands beside the sex word rather than around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer whose range lies between bass and tenor.

clue.text: Plunder lifted, apart from display of icons

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted means raised upward, so the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: loot means plunder
bar means except, as in all bar one

explanation.surface: Stolen goods were lifted, except from a display of religious icons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lifted' looks like stolen, matching 'plunder', but signals the word is turned upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A toolbar is a strip of clickable icons on a computer screen.

clue.text: One beginning to ascend to Saturn, perhaps

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of the word ascend is taken
perhaps suggests a possible variant, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone starting to climb towards Saturn, maybe.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer. 'perhaps' turns TO SATURN into STRONAUT.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronaut is a space traveller, here the one who might fly towards a planet.

clue.text: Socialist supporting Queen is messed up

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means placed underneath, so this word goes below

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the royal cipher of the Queen
red is a common label for a socialist or left-winger

explanation.surface: A left-winger backing the monarchy has made a hash of it.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to make a mistake, so erred means got it wrong.

clue.text: Behaviour of French, more disagreeable reportedly

parts.note: de is the French word for of

indicators.note: reportedly means as people say it, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: meaner means more unpleasant or nasty

explanation.surface: A complaint that the French are behaving more unpleasantly than usual, according to reports.
explanation.definitionFit: Demeanour is the way a person carries themself, their outward manner and conduct.

clue.text: Aquatic creature's fiercer blowing top

indicators.note: blowing its top means losing its head, so the word for fiercer drops its first letter

parts.note: a hotter temper or contest is a fiercer one

explanation.surface: An animal in the water is losing its temper, getting angrier until it explodes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blowing top' reads as losing one's temper, but here it says the top letter is lost. The 's is a link: the creature is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An otter is a sleek fish-eating mammal of rivers and coasts.

clue.text: Rubbish bin's first put in car port

indicators.note: put in means placed inside, so the letter goes into the building for cars

parts.note: a garage is a shelter where a car is kept

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the word bin is taken

explanation.surface: Instructions for where to leave a rubbish bin: in the carport first.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is household waste, the American word for refuse.

clue.text: Sun possibly turning a bit old

indicators.note: turning here means being changed around, so the letters of these three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: The sun, perhaps, is turning slightly old as the day ends.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British popular newspaper, not the star; 'possibly' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sun is a red-top British newspaper of the small-format popular kind, an example of the type.

clue.text: Tech company techie's opening small program

parts.note: Apple is the American technology company behind the iPhone

indicators.note: opening means the first letter, here of the word techie

explanation.surface: A technology firm and a programmer's first small piece of software.
explanation.definitionFit: An applet is a little application, a compact piece of software that runs inside another.

clue.text: Rendered insensible with drink

definitions.meaning: rendered here means coated with plaster, as a wall is

explanation.surface: Someone has been made senseless by alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rendered' looks like 'made' governing the rest, but it is a separate definition: a builder's term for a plaster coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall coated in render has been plastered; and plastered is also slang for very drunk.

clue.text: Craves food after detailed written description

indicators.note: after says the word for food is placed behind the shortened word
detailed is read as de-tailed, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: an entry is an item written in a dictionary or record
eats is informal for food

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a meal after reading an elaborate menu write-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' looks like 'thorough' but means with its tail cut: ENTRY becomes ENTR.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to beg earnestly, close in sense to craving as asking for something badly.

clue.text: Active agent accepts true-blue line

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so the agent word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
true-blue means loyally Conservative, i.e. on the political right

explanation.surface: An energetic secret agent toes the loyal Tory line.
explanation.walkthrough: True-blue in Britain means staunchly Conservative, blue being the Tory colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprightly means lively and full of energy, an active person in spirit.

clue.text: Backlash created by an erotic novel

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters of these words are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An erotic novel causing public outrage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like a book, fitting 'erotic', but means new.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaction is a response against something, such as a backlash of public opinion.

clue.text: Tit's head emerged from egg covered in straw

indicators.note: head means the top letter of the word tit

parts.note: a chick that has hatched has come out of its egg

explanation.surface: A baby tit has come out of its egg in a straw-lined nest.
explanation.definitionFit: A thatched roof is one covered with straw or reeds laid in thick layers.

clue.text: Profile criminal preceding visit

indicators.note: preceding means coming before, so the criminal word goes first

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
a tour is a visit around a place

explanation.surface: A police description of a criminal before a prison visit.
explanation.definitionFit: A contour is an outline of a shape, the same as a profile.

clue.text: Fine performer creating part

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
an actor is a stage or screen performer

explanation.surface: A good performer creating a role in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part' looks like an acting role, fitting the surface, but it means one element among several.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is one element contributing to a result, a component or part of the whole.

clue.text: Ace compiler's not so rambling

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
the compiler's voice says I'm, compiler is I, and 's is am
less means not so much

explanation.surface: A top setter boasting their clues ramble less than others.
explanation.walkthrough: The compiler is the crossword setter, who speaks as 'I'; 'compiler's' is 'I am', I'M.
explanation.definitionFit: Aimless means without direction or purpose, like rambling talk or walking.

clue.text: End of leg split on exercise producing infection

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word leg is taken

parts.note: a rip is a split or tear
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: A leg split open during exercise leads to an infection.
explanation.definitionFit: Grippe is an old word, borrowed from French, for influenza, a viral infection.

clue.text: Settled with a devil, almost devilish

parts.note: sat means settled into a seat

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: Old Nick is a name for the Devil

explanation.surface: Someone did a deal with a devil, and that is almost devilish.
explanation.walkthrough: Nick (as in Old Nick) is a traditional nickname for the Devil.
explanation.definitionFit: Satanic means like or belonging to Satan, so wicked or devilish.

clue.text: Work out seeing overly large veins engorged initially

indicators.note: initially means taking the first letter of each of these words in turn

explanation.surface: A trip to the gym: noticing hugely swollen veins after a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Work out' suggests the gym, matching the veins, but means find the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To solve a problem is to work out its answer.

clue.text: Old politician kept in loop? That's sporting

indicators.note: kept in means held inside, so these letters sit within the circle

parts.note: a ring is a closed loop
MP stands for Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An elderly politician kept in the loop; is that sporting of them?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sporting' looks like 'fair', but it means frolicking in play.
explanation.definitionFit: Romping and sporting both mean playing boisterously and frolicking about.

clue.text: Pine to follow one's dream

indicators.note: to follow means coming after, so the pine word goes after the numeral

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one; the 's is a link
deal is softwood timber such as pine or fir

explanation.surface: Pining to chase one's dream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pine' reads as yearn, fitting 'dream', but is the wood: deal is pine or fir timber.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal is a perfect standard one aspires to, a dream to aim at.

clue.text: Slow fabulous ship on west side of lake

indicators.note: in an across clue the west side is the left end, so the first letter of lake is taken

parts.note: the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek legend

explanation.surface: A legendary ship moves slowly along the west shore of a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fabulous' means of fable, not marvellous.
explanation.definitionFit: Largo is the musical tempo marking for a slow, broad pace.

clue.text: Simple men tend to purchase gadget

indicators.note: purchase can mean grip or hold, so the letters are held within these words

explanation.surface: A dig that unsophisticated men like buying gadgets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Purchase' reads as buying but means hold, as a firm purchase on a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: An implement is a tool or device used for a job, much like a gadget.

clue.text: Finish United's competition gaining new stamina

parts.note: end means finish
U is the abbreviation for United in football team names

indicators.note: gaining means taking on an extra piece inside, so a letter goes into the contest word

parts.note: a race is a competition

explanation.surface: A football club, United, ends its competition run by finding new fitness.
explanation.definitionFit: Endurance is the ability to keep going under strain, the same staying power as stamina.

clue.text: Smooth character in empty suavity

indicators.note: in means placed inside the shell left by emptying the word suavity
empty means all the middle letters are removed, leaving only the outer two

parts.note: ilk means type or character, as in people of that ilk

explanation.surface: Someone's character shows inside an empty, smooth-talking manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Silky means soft and smooth like silk, to the touch or in manner.
